_note: The text of Compare views (TRD addendum 6.5, issue #202). diff: {kept}, {from}, {to}, {a} and {b} are the labels of terminals in the lesson file. Write the text in ASD-STE100.

door.label: Arduino Foundations · Level {level}
door.title: Same circuit, three worlds
door.text: See one LED circuit as a schematic, as a 3D board and as a photo of a real circuit.

compare.title: Same circuit, three worlds
compare.intro: This is one circuit in more than one view. Select a point or a connection in a view. The other views show the same point.
compare.boardHint: The 3D board is above. Point at a hole or tap it to select its connection.
compare.schematicLabel: Schematic of the LED circuit. It is a reference view: it does not change when you change your board.
compare.none: Nothing is selected. Select a point or a connection.
compare.notOnBoard: This part is not on your board now.

difference.title: Your board and the reference
difference.same: Your board has the same connections as the reference.
difference.count: Your board has {n} differences from the reference. The schematic and the photo show the reference.
difference.countOne: Your board has 1 difference from the reference. The schematic and the photo show the reference.
difference.moved: {kept} was connected to {from}. Now it is connected to {to}.
difference.added: {a} and {b} are connected now. In the reference, they are not connected.

photo.title: Photo of the real circuit
photo.absent: The photo view is not here yet. It comes when the photos of the real circuit are added to this lesson.
photo.points: Select a point on the photo, or select a point or a connection in a different view.
photo.oneEnd: This photo shows one end of this connection only.

fault.title: A fault on the real circuit

question.transfer: The same circuit, in a different layout
question.saveFailed: We could not save your answer. Your board and your answers are still on this device.
